self_determination: Self-determination of peoples: the right of peoples and nations to self-determination, permanent sovereignty over natural resources, and whether an article on it belongs in the covenants
two_covenants: One covenant or two: whether economic, social and cultural rights belong in the covenant, and whether there should be one covenant or two separate ones; the two kinds of rights compared as a reason for either
implementation: Measures of implementation: how the covenants are to be implemented and supervised in general: a human rights committee, State reports, complaints between States, the role of the Economic and Social Council and the specialized agencies (individual petitions are a question of their own)
petitions: Petitions from individuals and groups: whether individuals, groups or non-governmental organizations may petition or complain to an international body (the right of petition), in the declaration or the covenants
federal_clause: Federal clause: how the covenants bind a federal State whose constituent states or provinces hold the powers concerned (the federal clause)
territorial_clause: Territorial (colonial) clause: whether and how the covenants or the declaration apply to non-self-governing and trust territories (the territorial or colonial application clause)
reservations: Reservations: whether States may make reservations to the covenants, and on what terms
form_of_bill: Form of the International Bill of Rights: whether the International Bill of Rights should be a declaration, a convention (covenant), measures of implementation, or all of these, and how they relate (the debates of 1947-48)
general: General debate: the declaration or the covenant(s) as a whole, or several of the questions at once, none of them dominating
